profile:
COMPANY NAME: DoorDash
INDUSTRY: On-demand delivery / Marketplace
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: A digital platform that connects consumers with local restaurants, grocery stores, and retailers for same-day delivery and pickup of food, groceries, alcohol, and general merchandise.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Consumers seeking convenient food and grocery delivery; local merchants and restaurants looking to expand reach; independent delivery drivers (Dashers) seeking flexible income.
PRICING MODEL: Freemium (DashPass subscription for reduced fees) / Transaction-based (delivery and service fees)
KEY FEATURES:
- Multi-category marketplace including food, grocery, convenience, alcohol, flowers, and pet supplies.
- DashPass subscription offering $0 delivery fees and exclusive savings.
- DashMart, a proprietary virtual store for fresh groceries and essentials.
- Package Pickup service for prepaid carrier packages (UPS, FedEx, USPS).
- Flexible scheduling for independent delivery drivers.
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- "Everything you crave, delivered" in one app, consolidating multiple errands.
- Empowers local economies by connecting local merchants with new customers.
- Offers 0% commission for up to 30 days for new merchants.
- Claims to be the #1 Food and Drink App in the U.S.
TONE & POSITIONING: Consumer-friendly / Convenience-focused / Community-oriented
